title: Insurance, Takaful and Financial Protection
introduction: Explore insurance, takaful and financial protection using everyday examples.
definition: Insurance provides specified protection against risks in exchange for a premium. Takaful uses a mutual assistance arrangement with participant contributions. Protection depends on the contract, limits and exclusions; it is not a guarantee that every loss is paid.

examples.question: A simplified protection plan costs RM20 monthly.

exercises.question: RM15 monthly for 12 months. Annual cost?
RM120 yearly contribution split equally over 12 months. Monthly?
Covered loss RM500, stated benefit RM350. Uncovered amount?
Two hypothetical annual premiums RM180 and RM240. Difference?
